name: Webvisor x-frame
project_description: Xframe Allow Webvisor is a single-purpose module that lets Yandex Metrica WebVisor (a session-replay analytics tool) load the site inside an iframe. WebVisor renders the page in a frame to record and replay visitor sessions, which Drupal's default framing policy blocks. The module registers one kernel-response event subscriber (XframeSubscriber) that, on every response, sets a Content-Security-Policy header whose value is a frame-ancestors directive listing the site itself plus the Yandex WebVisor / Metrica origins. It ships no settings form, no configuration, no permissions and no routes; enabling the module is the whole of the configuration.
